title: Have A Nice Day (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 108bpm walking bass brushed drums harmonica honest working man character portrait unhurried
lyrics:
[Intro - warm acoustic blues, unhurried]
My dad is a big man
A bricklayer
Not a complicated man
But a precise one

[Verse 1]
Train station, early morning
Man walks up, looks him up and down
Hey mate, got a smoke
Dad says no

Man says well how about you get us both one
Dad says nothing for a moment
Man comes back with two cigarettes
Hands one over

Dad takes it
Snaps it clean
Says I don't smoke
Man says oh

[Pre-Chorus]
Man says have you got a dollar
Dad says yes, sure do
Have a nice day
Gets on the train

[Chorus]
That's just who he is
No argument, no explanation
That's just who he is
He doesn't need to tell you twice
He says what's true
He does what's right
And he gets on the train
That's just who he is

[Verse 2]
Ticket inspector works the carriage
Walks straight past the ones without a ticket
People with no money, people looking away
Walks straight up to Dad

Ticket please
Dad says check them first
Sir we don't want a problem here
I can have you removed from this service

Dad says check them first
Sir
Check them first

[Bridge - spoken, level as concrete]
Inspector goes back
Starts checking
Lot of swearing
Lot of carrying on
No tickets
Off the train

Man at the back points at Dad
I will get you
Dad says ok
Looks at the inspector
Here's my ticket

[Chorus]
That's just who he is
No argument, no explanation
That's just who he is
He doesn't need to tell you twice
He says what's true
He does what's right
And he shows his ticket
That's just who he is

[Verse 3]
First and only time
He ever rode a train in Australia
One trip
Both directions sorted in the first five minutes

He didn't make a scene
He didn't raise his voice
He didn't need to
He just held his ground
Like a man who lays bricks for a living
Knows where things belong

[Outro - guitar settles, warm and still]
He is not a complicated man
But he is a precise one
He knew who had a ticket
And he knew who didn't
And he knew which one he was
Have a nice day
